cards.explanation: The answer is the seed of man and of beast. The LORD says, “…I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and of beast.” Think about that for a second, friends. He's sowing PEOPLE and animals like they're a crop. The only thing I've ever sowed is flour all over my counter.

The word is plant. The LORD says, “…so I will watch over them to build and to plant…” and He says it with the same watching He used for the uprooting. Uprooting and tearing down on one side, building and planting on the other. I know a little about being put away in the dark and then set somewhere new, and I can tell you the second part is better.

The answer is True. The LORD says, “Instead, each will die for his own iniquity.” Then He adds, “If anyone eats the sour grapes, his own teeth will be set on edge.” So whoever eats the sour grapes is the one who makes the face. I ate a lemon cookie once by accident and I'm still not over it.

The answer is Egypt. The LORD says the new covenant will not be like the one He made with their fathers “…when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt…” Taken by the hand. That's a picture I like a lot, friends. I know what it's like when somebody finally reaches in and takes hold of you.

The answer is in their minds and on their hearts. The LORD says, “I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts.” Not just somewhere they have to go look at it. It goes inside them.

The reason is that they will all know Him. The LORD says no one will need to say, “Know the LORD…” “because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest…” That's everybody, the least to the greatest. Nobody gets left standing at the back of the line.

The answer is False, and that's the good news. The LORD says, “For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.” Forgiven, and remembered no more. Friends, that's the kind of promise you read twice just to make sure it's still there.

The answer is only if that fixed order left His presence. The LORD says, “Only if this fixed order departed from My presence, declares the LORD, would Israel’s descendants ever cease to be a nation before Me.” The fixed order is the sun by day and the moon and stars by night. Those just keep showing up. I hope that's the kind of promise it is, friends.

The word is reject. The LORD says, “Only if the heavens above could be measured and the foundations of the earth below searched out would I reject all of Israel’s descendants because of all they have done…” Measuring the heavens, and I couldn't even measure a cup of flour right on my first day.

The answer is False, and the last line says it plain. The LORD says the whole valley of the dead bodies and ashes “…will be holy to the LORD.” Then He finishes with, “It will never again be uprooted or demolished.”
